name: ikmal-editor
description: Workspace root. It exists so the TypeScript compiler and the browser test harnesses are declared rather than assumed to be installed on the machine: the packagers and verifiers shell out to `tsc`, and a fresh clone or a CI runner has no global one.

scripts.test: npm run test --workspaces --if-present && npm run test:units
scripts.verify: node tools/verify_desktop.mjs && node tools/verify_extension.mjs && node tools/verify_firefox_extension.mjs && node tools/verify_vscode_extension.mjs && node tools/verify_office_bridge.mjs && node tools/verify_integrations.mjs && node tools/verify_editor_assets.mjs && node tools/verify_browser_rewrite.mjs && node tools/verify_desktop_rewrite.mjs && node tools/verify_rewrite_final.mjs && node tools/generate_marks.mjs --check
scripts.smoke:docker: bash tools/docker_smoke.sh && bash tools/integration_docker_smoke.sh && bash tools/libreoffice_docker_smoke.sh
